name: linear-modal-center-content
title: Linear Modal Centered
blurb: Animates from card to full-screen centered dialog with spring easing.
description: A layered modal that morphs from a trigger element to a centered, expanded view. Animated with spring physics (Framer Motion). Content scales and fades in while a backdrop blurs and darkens, with support for images and scrollable…
use_when: You need a dramatic reveal from a card or button to a large modal with rich, scrollable content.
avoid_when: Users need instant, undecorated feedback — the spring animation adds 500ms latency.
a11y: Full keyboard support: Tab cycles focus within modal, Escape closes, Enter/Space opens. Manages document scroll and body overflow. Provides ARIA labels for dialog role and semantic structure.
